meta.title: Snap & Forget — MOT, passport and warranty reminders
meta.description: Snap a passport, MOT, insurance or warranty. We email you the date. You can ignore the app for a year.

landing.headline: Snap the paper. Forget it.
landing.sub: Passport, ID, MOT, insurance, warranty, pet vaccine, boiler check. The slip vanishes. We ping you in time.
landing.trust: Three documents free. No card needed.
landing.hero_ping: MOT ends soon. Book now, not in the queue.
landing.step1: The stamp at the test station, the sticker in the car, the warranty receipt, or the last page of a passport.
landing.step2: AI reads the expiry from the photo. You check it. Reminders at 30, 7 and 1 day before are on by default.
landing.step3: You don't have to open the app. The date hits your calendar. We only interrupt when it matters.
landing.why_title: Why not a calendar or ChatGPT
landing.why1_title: A calendar can do this. Nobody types it in.
landing.why1: You're at the test station with ink on your hands. Here you just take a photo. In a year you won't open Google Calendar for this.
landing.why2_title: ChatGPT will not ping you in 11 months.
landing.why2: AI can read the paper. It will not store the date, keep the receipt photo, or remind you to claim the warranty.
landing.why3_title: One missed MOT pays for years of this.
landing.why3: A fine, a tow, a queue. Or a dead washing machine just outside warranty because the receipt vanished.
landing.price_note: Unlimited documents, calendar, photos. One avoided fine covers it.
landing.footer: Photos stay on our server. We remind you by email of dates you save — the document itself is still on you.

legal.who_p: The controller of your data is {name}. Contact: {email}.
legal.what_p: Email, a hashed password, language, documents you add (type, title, expiry, notes), photos you upload, reminder settings, and short technical logs (login, mail sent, errors). If you connect Google Calendar we store tokens needed to create events.
legal.why_p: We need this to run your account, show your documents, and email reminders before expiry. That is the contract of the service. Logs exist so we can fix failures and abuse.
legal.photos_p: You may upload photos of passports, IDs, MOT slips and similar papers. They stay on our EU server for your account only. Other users cannot see them. Do not upload photos of other people without a reason to keep them here.
legal.ai_p: If AI scan is on, a compressed copy of the photo is sent to Google Gemini so we can suggest a type and date. Google is a processor outside the EU; that transfer is needed for the scan. You always confirm the date yourself. You can skip the scan and type the date.
legal.mail_p: Reminder and reset emails go through our mail provider (currently Resend). The app and photos are hosted in the EU (planned: Hetzner). We do not sell your data.
legal.keep_p: We keep your data until you delete the account or a document. After deletion, photos and personal records are removed. Backups may linger a few days until they rotate.
legal.cookies_p: We only use cookies that make the app work: a login session, a security token, and your language. No advertising cookies.
legal.rights_p: You can access, correct and erase your data. Erase it in Account, or email us. You can complain to your EU data protection authority (in Slovakia: Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov). This notice is the short version required to run the service; it is not a substitute for advice about your documents.
legal.terms_p1: Snap & Forget / Odfoť a zabudni reminds you of dates you save. It is not legal, tax or motoring advice. You are responsible for the dates you confirm.
legal.terms_p2: The free plan is three documents. Paid plans, when offered, are billed as shown in the app.
legal.terms_p3: You must not upload illegal material or try to break the service. We may close accounts that abuse scans, mail or storage.
legal.terms_p4: The service may change or stop. We are not liable for a missed appointment, fine or expired document.
legal.terms_p5: These terms are governed by Slovak law. Questions: {email}.
